title: He’s the Top Snake Catcher, and Business Is Booming. There’s Just One Problem.
summary: Bangkok’s firefighters do more snake catching than firefighting, and Pinyo Pukpinyo trains them. But he refuses to kill the snakes, and he’s running out of containers.
